criteria.contract: Pin a new opt-in NPC policy in new games. Keep previous first-inspection-only and null policies byte-compatible. Registered adult NPCs and authored historical adults use the same existing command and report pipeline; never control the player or minors.

Choose a local inspection only from the NPC own missing/stale road observations, actual available permission and own received result. At most one new autonomous inspection per person per day. Fresh observations, pending reports, military/custody/companion tasks prevent inappropriate work; never read hidden road truth to plan.

Continue across days and local positions with immutable decision input snapshots and deterministic ordering. Actual completed work can earn existing skill experience; no invented offices, army, wealth or automatic relationships.

Exercise multiple active registered NPCs across the existing national nodes and bounded event budgets. Record measured scope; do not claim the product target of 3000 active people, 1000 sites and 500 armies was reached.

Verify current public APIs, stale/hidden knowledge, occupancy, same future after real generation recovery, old-save bytes, entry policy and headless Godot data projection. GUI appearance and full nationwide strategic AI remain unfinished.

limits: 活動規模の実測は登録24人を含む29 NPC・既存の複数拠点・世界生成からゲーム内20秒までの共通実務。個別ケースは6451ms（旧保存検査が同時実行）、一括検査中は42853ms。FPSや3000人/1000拠点/500軍の製品目標を達成した検査ではない。今回の自律行動は現地の自己点検に限定し、仕官先探し・外交・独立・軍の自主作戦・人生全体の優先順位は未実装。通常の新規ゲームに新方式を接続し、既存GUI検査用の明示旧方式は保持。
